current_findings.title: Employee/audit lock inversion deadlocks a real approval
current_findings.evidence: A synchronized native test reproduced PostgreSQL deadlock.c/DeadLockReport before the fix. Workflow creation/action/resubmission/escalation/routing repair now lock subject before request/step/audit. The same native scenario passes; no retry or global timeout weakening was used. Final audit writes now follow domain effects; native tests cover waits on both employee and attendance-day rows.
current_findings.remaining: This proves the repaired workflow/domain boundary, not a universal lock-order proof for every older financial/lifecycle service.

current_findings.title: Editable chains can skip required authority through duplicate numbers or invalid approver specifications
current_findings.evidence: Duplicate step numbers, misspelled approvers and invalid escalation targets now reject before persistence. Runtime reads validate the same contract.
current_findings.remaining: Native legacy claim and travel_budget each contain an invalid second approver specification. They fail closed and require configured-chain repair in the deferred claim/budget work; seed preserves runtime edits.

current_findings.title: All-vacant rounds previously finalized without an approver
current_findings.evidence: New/resubmitted all-vacant rounds remain pending with audit, configured HR event and requester notification. Scoped admin.settings list/retry is audited, excludes readonly grants and cannot approve; concurrent retries create one step. Real OD remains unapplied. Configured OT lapse remains enforced. Request detail displays Waiting for HR.
current_findings.remaining: Existing approved requests are not retroactively reversed. Historical test DB has 98 overtime and 52 privacy_rights approved requests with no step rows; origin/retention needs review before using them as acceptance evidence.

current_findings.title: Central readonly grants can be treated as mutation authority
current_findings.evidence: RBAC accepts readonly for arbitrary permission codes; getUserPermissionAccess maps readonly to all; withPermission checks presence without distinguishing read/write before mutating handlers. The new routing-repair SQL explicitly excludes readonly and has a native 403 test.
current_findings.remaining: Design and apply a central read/write authority contract across existing mutation procedures, preserving legitimate readonly report access. Separate foundation-stage repair; no broad RBAC change silently applied here.

current_findings.title: Product screens call HTTP paths that the current server does not serve
current_findings.evidence: Runtime OpenAPI has 250 paths/268 operations. AST scan found 165 literal/template calls and 9 unresolved dynamic calls. Thirty initial mismatches include six manually excluded conditional-method/query-suffix false positives; 24 remain candidates. Ten loopback probes confirm selected client URLs return 404 while actual generated URLs reach 401 authentication. Loan routes include a second /api prefix; separation clients use paths/methods differing from generated procedures.
current_findings.remaining: Repair contract/client/auth/payload ownership per domain and prove end-to-end. A matching URL alone does not establish compatible output or permission scope. Claims/budgets remain deferred.

schema_9_findings_retained.title: Two independent bill-required flags on one claim type
schema_9_findings_retained.problem: requires_bill and bill_required express the same bill-required decision but are stored independently without an equality constraint or reconciliation. The current entitlement reader uses bill_required; the earlier taxonomy seeded requires_bill. Submission always requires a bill regardless of either value. is_taxable and taxable_if_unsubstantiated are different concepts and must not be merged just because both are booleans.
schema_9_findings_retained.decision: Canonicalize the bill policy after comparing existing values and the two workflows; expose one authoritative value. Keep current-claim taxability separate from year-end taxability on unsubstantiated entitlement. Use expand/contract compatibility before retiring a proven duplicate. No column was dropped.
schema_9_findings_retained.status: Open; audit only, no source/schema repair in this pass

schema_9_findings_retained.title: Claims DB, Kysely types and output schema disagree about states
schema_9_findings_retained.problem: DB allows nine claim states; the authoritative Database ClaimStatus allows only pending/verified/approved/rejected/paid. It cannot represent draft/submitted/sent_back/settled. The output zod enum is also five-state. A separate exported PayClaimsTable has the opposite narrower travel vocabulary and declares budget/reference non-null, while DB permits NULL. These are conflicting contracts, not extra DB columns.
schema_9_findings_retained.decision: Define one canonical DB row type and explicit supported workflow transitions; align input/output contracts with the intended flow. Filter/route distinct funding flows explicitly; broadening an enum alone does not make the claims API work.

schema_9_findings_retained.title: Financial facts still permit competing or mutable truth
schema_9_findings_retained.problem: loan_postings has no UPDATE/DELETE rejecting trigger and no unique loan/run key. Claims settlement directly changes loans.outstanding without a posting. payroll_item_lines lacks a closed-run immutability trigger; the header/item guard covers only UPDATE/DELETE. paid_in_run_id and paid_in_batch_id lack the documented payout exclusivity CHECK; a linked obligation is currently labelled paid before actual payment evidence.
schema_9_findings_retained.decision: The principal, ledger and payout references are legitimate fields. Make immutable postings/payment events authoritative, retain a cache only if explicitly derived and reconcilable, enforce once-only source consumption and closed-result inserts/updates/deletes, and distinguish routed/approved/paid states.

schema_9_findings_retained.title: Known relational/date/money invariants are missing
schema_9_findings_retained.problem: Several known same-database relations are only BIGINT fields without FK enforcement, including settlement-to-separation and the indicated workflow references. salary_holds has no date-order CHECK. claim_entitlements has neither a nonnegative amount CHECK nor an effective bucket uniqueness/overlap invariant. These omissions leave legitimate fields weakly connected.
schema_9_findings_retained.decision: Reconcile invalid existing references first, then introduce safe forward constraints and semantic same-owner checks. Choose approved effective-entitlement interval semantics. Polymorphic reference_id/entity_id, external ATS IDs and textual mobile device IDs are not automatically missing-FK defects.

schema_9_findings_retained.title: Claim funding and component ownership remain incomplete
schema_9_findings_retained.problem: General claim submission omits funding_kind, so the local budget default conflicts with the required budget_id check when no budget is supplied. payout_component_code defaults to REIMB with no FK on that taxonomy field; no REIMB seed exists in the checked payroll code. claim_lines and claim_bills represent travel line items and general bill verification differently; their ownership/payout linkage is not unified.
schema_9_findings_retained.decision: Preserve both documented funding modes and define required keys per mode. Configure and FK the actual payout component; do not invent a fallback component. Preserve multi-line/multi-currency receipt facts and document ownership, then prove each mode through approval, settlement and one real payout.

schema_9_findings_retained.title: Future test partitions explain physical growth, not new business fields
schema_9_findings_retained.problem: Compared with the 13 Oct catalog, 12 new swipe partitions exist, including dates in 2032–2081. Business column definitions are unchanged. Tests use random future dates and the ingestion service creates month partitions; exact causation for each new partition was not traced. This is local test schema growth, not 12 new business models.
schema_9_findings_retained.decision: Keep test-only provenance clear and bound fixtures/isolate destructive test setup. No production concern is inferred from this user-authorized local test DB. Do not remove append-only evidence or partitions without a reviewed retention/fixture cleanup procedure.
